sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Apex sensitivity and FOV. Apex's higher FOV default (110) vs Valorant (103) affects perceived sensitivity.
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_2Desc: The converted Valorant sensitivity accounts for FOV differences between the two games for a more accurate feel translation.
steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Valorant. Expect an adjustment period — Apex's fast movement contrasts with Valorant's tactical, hold-angle playstyle.
